notes: The builder's exception (CCP_SETUP_FETCH=0 not set, so setup.sh's docs-skill npm ci still runs in these tests) is sound: in setup.sh that switch also skips step 0's git fetch origin main (the 'clone fast-forwarded' assertion) and step 2's fetch of release tags and branches (how harness-v9.0.0, v1.2.3, v0.0.9 and release/harness-v9.1.0 made on origin after the first install are seen), so with it set tests 1, 2, 3 and 6 would test nothing. With the inherited environment the npm ci is fast: the whole file runs in 34 s here (was 661 s), and CI's whole test job took 2m16s. The non_goals rule out a new setup.sh switch, so this is the right cut.

Edge outside the Expect line: if the clone the tests run in has a local release/harness-v* branch at the very commit of a detached HEAD (e.g. after release.mjs branch at a detached checkout of main), git clone checks that branch out, the test then deletes it, and copy-not-link fails with "fatal: Failed to resolve 'HEAD' as a valid ref" (seen here). no-self-edit's world() has the same shape (pre-existing). A 'git -C <clone> checkout -q --detach' before deleting the refs would close it; small enough for a later item, not a reason to hold this one.

trace-writes.mjs --keep uses renameSync from os.tmpdir(), which would fail with EXDEV if the --keep path is on another file system; same file system in this container, so not exercised. A copy-then-remove would close it.
